newsitem.title: UK: Saudi leaves Arab Medium to Europe unchanged in Fe.
newsitem.headline: Saudi leaves Arab Medium to Europe unchanged in Fe.

text.p: Saudi Arabia left unchanged the price of its Arab Medium crude for European customers in February, traders said on Thursday.

Arab Medium will be priced at Dated Brent less $3.05 a barrel in February, fob basis Ras Tanura, they said. For those customers lifting the grade fob Sidi Kreir, it will be priced at Dated Brent less $2.45 a barrel.
Traders said earlier on Tuesday Saudi Aramco also rolled January prices for Arab Light, Heavy and Berri Extra Light into February.
